subject: general
question: In Assembly Election 2022, how many seats did Aam Aadmi Party win in Punjab ?
solution:
The correct answer is **92**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Punjab held legislative assembly elections on February 20, 2022, to choose the **117 members** of the province's 16th assembly.
 
• By winning** 92 out of 117 seats**, the** Aam Aadmi **secured a commanding **79% majority in the 16th Punjab Legislative Assembly.**
 
• On March 16, 2022, **AAP Punjab** convener and MP Bhagwant Mann took the oath of office as chief executive.
 
• On March 19, 2022, Bhagwant Mann's ministry was established with 10 cabinet members.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Aam Aadmi Party**

 
 
• **India's Aam Aadmi Party** is one of its political parties. In November 2012,** Arvind Kejriwal **and his former colleagues founded AAP in response to the Indian anti-corruption campaign that began in 2011.
 
• **AAP currently oversees Punjab and Delhi.**
 
• **Election symbol** for the party is a **broom**.
 
• The party was established following a dispute between activist **Kejriwal** and **Indian Anna Hazare** about the incorporation of electoral politics into the well-known 2011 anti-corruption movement, which had been demanding a **Jan Lokpal Bill **since 2011.​
